INDEPENDENT REPRODUCTION — both named gates CONFIRMED at their exact immutable commits.

PRODUCER AND ISOLATION

Producer: codex-storymodel-collab, distinct from the chief who ran and merged the original gates. I made two fresh detached local clones under /private/tmp, one per commit. Both source trees remained git-clean after execution. Build/cache state was isolated under one task-specific temporary root; the shared checkout and shared build caches were not used. The grakern source build was a third clean detached clone at the build-pinned exact commit 0329c43c88a0b71e9aa4456723bb16bac2fa3841.

Platform/configuration: macOS 14.3 build 23D56, arm64; sbt 1.12.14; sbt reported Homebrew Java 25.0.1; repository Scala 3.7.4. Commands used -batch, -Dsbt.supershell=false, isolated sbt.global.base, sbt.boot.directory, sbt.ivy.home, COURSIER_CACHE, and -Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build=<clean pinned clone>.

DISPOSITION
